components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--radius-card, 16px); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-stage-start, #161414) 0%, var(--color-stage-end, #100f10) 100%); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.085)); box-shadow: var(--surface-specular-highlight, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)); font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)); } .ds-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-company { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink-primary, #f8f6f4); } .ds-pill-current { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--color-accent-tint-ink, #f69a76); background: var(--color-accent-tint-bg, rgba(242, 120, 75, 0.14)); border: 1px solid rgba(242, 120, 75, 0.28); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink-primary, #f8f6f4); } .ds-card-summary { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.59; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a19c98); } .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.085)); } .ds-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-secondary-bg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.048)); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a19c98); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.085)); }

narrative.overview:
This portfolio is built as a dark-obsidian engineering folio where structural clarity replaces ornament. Surfaces stay quiet and low-contrast on an Obsidian Canvas illuminated only by a restrained overhead copper glow and a faint, masked 24px drafting dot-grid. Every visual decision reinforces evidence-led engineering craft: generous vertical rhythm, warm neutral ink calibrated against halation, and hairline glass plates that hold experience and repository proof without competing with it.

Warm Copper is the single brand voice. It behaves like an etched signal line—anchoring primary calls to action, active navigation indicators, focus rings, and current-role tenure pills—while semantic green, amber, and red remain strictly reserved for real system states (availability, copy confirmation, in-progress badges, and errors). There is no logo or monogram; the full name set in Instrument Sans is the centered typographic centerpiece.
keyCharacteristics: Dark obsidian ground with a warm overhead copper radial wash and subtle masked 24px dot-grid
Warm-tinted neutral hierarchy (Obsidian Canvas, Smoked Charcoal plates, Warm Alabaster and Stone Muted ink)
Single brand accent in Kiln Copper and Copper Glow, paired with strict semantic-only status tones
Layered 1px specular hairline glass cards with flat-by-default tonal separation
Self-hosted Instrument Sans + JetBrains Mono with optical tracking and leading lift for dark-mode legibility

rules.name: The Single-Accent Signal Rule
rules.body: Warm Copper is the only brand color; it is reserved for primary actions, active route/section state, focus rings, and current-role emphasis—never decorative fills or competing secondary brand hues.

rules.name: The Real-State Semantic Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red tokens appear only for real system states (availability, clipboard status, in-progress work, errors), never as decorative tags or category color-coding.

rules.name: The Anti-Halation Lift Rule
rules.body: Light ink on dark obsidian always carries the subtle optical tracking (+0.008em) and leading (+0.04) offset so dense prose never blooms or cramps.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Dates, tenure ranges, capability metrics, and technical metadata use JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns and badges align cleanly.

rules.name: The Specular Hairline Rule
rules.body: Cards convey depth through a 1px top-edge specular inset and subtle tonal gradient rather than bright drop shadows or neon glows.

dos: Do keep Warm Copper (#cc471b / #f2784b) as the sole brand accent, reserving green/amber/red strictly for real system states.
Do maintain 44px minimum hit targets and the 2px #f2784b :focus-visible outline (3px offset) across all links and buttons.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by eliminating hover transforms and collapsing transition durations to 0.01ms.
Do use JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for dates, tenures, stack tags, and technical metadata.
Do keep typography self-hosted (Instrument Sans + JetBrains Mono WOFF2) with zero runtime third-party font or API fetches.
donts: Don't introduce a logo, monogram, or decorative icon chrome in the header; the full name is the centerpiece.
Don't add heavy neon glows, saturated gradients on cards, or competing secondary accent colors.
Don't use pure #000000 or pure #ffffff for body copy/surfaces (except text on solid copper CTAs); keep the warm-tinted Obsidian and Alabaster ink pair.
Don't ship real product screenshots, proprietary internals, or unverified metrics that violate the NDA boundary.
